title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・キーワード③

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: How romantic the rivalries that spur personal growth, like chestnuts roasting on an open fire! …What is Gold Ship even talking about?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her idioms may be cryptic, but her victory in the autumn Tenno Sho is clear as day. With a rematch against Tosen Jordan on the horizon, a new clue has fallen into Gold Ship's lap. Splendid!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The night after the race, Gold Ship has a dream again. In it, a voice calls her a "ship of gold," but the speaker's identity remains hidden.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship realizes Nakayama Festa's voice sounds surprisingly similar to the one in her dream. The speaker's identity is slowly coming to light.
